description: This source file defines a Spring component 'CurrentUser' that provides methods to retrieve the current user's ID and roles, as well as to check role membership. It serves as a placeholder for user authentication information, likely used for authorization and auditing purposes within the application.

classes.name: CurrentUser
classes.description: A Spring component that manages retrieval of current user information, including user ID and roles, for security and auditing purposes.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns a placeholder user ID. Intended to be integrated with real authentication context.

methods.name: getRoles
methods.description: Returns a set of roles assigned to the current user, currently hardcoded as a placeholder.

methods.name: hasRole
methods.description: Checks whether the current user has a specific role.
